column3: MT 5:15. “A friend all the days” is rendered “had always been a friend.”
MT 5:17. “The war” is rendered “the wars”; the Hebrew reads “under the soles of my feet” (written text), and NASB has “his feet.”
MT 5:19. “I am saying” is rendered “I intend.”
MT 5:23. NASB supplies “to go by sea” and “have them broken up.”
MT 5:31. “To found the house” is rendered “to lay the foundation of the house.”
